terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: {brand} is a free bulletin board: it connects people looking for a lost pet, who found an animal, want to rehome one or need help, with the people nearby who can help. By using it you accept these rules.
terms.intermediary_title: We put people in touch, nothing more
terms.intermediary_body: We are not a party to the agreements between people who use {brand}. We show posts and put people in touch; whatever they agree is their own responsibility.
terms.adoption_body: An adoption is an agreement between the adopter and the publisher. We don't approve adopters or decide who owns an animal.
terms.money_body: {brand} does not receive, hold, transfer or show money: there are no donations and no fees. Help is in kind — a temporary home, a ride, supplies — and is arranged between people.
terms.badges_body: A verification badge means we reviewed a document. It is not a guarantee about the person or the foundation.
terms.content_body: Only post true cases about real animals. Don't post other people's personal data or violent or misleading content. Anyone can report a post, and we may hide or remove what breaks these rules.
terms.account_body: You sign in with Google or with a code we email you: there are no passwords. To post, we ask for a mobile number, verified once.
terms.care_title: When handing over or receiving an animal
terms.care_body: Ask for proof it's theirs — an earlier photo, a detail that isn't in the post, the vaccination card — and do the handover in a public place.
terms.liability_body: We offer {brand} as is. We are not responsible for what people agree or do between themselves, nor for the accuracy of what they post.
terms.changes_body: If we change these terms, we'll say so in the app before they apply.

privacy.title: Data processing policy
privacy.intro: How {brand} processes your personal data, under Colombia's Law 1581 of 2012.
privacy.controller_body: {brand} is responsible for processing your data. For any question or complaint, write to {contact}.
privacy.data_body: Your name, your email, your mobile number if you post or leave one, the approximate location of posts and sightings, photos and what you write. We don't ask for your address, ID document, date of birth or gender.
privacy.purpose_body: To publish and show posts, tell you about sightings and replies, put helpers in touch with the people searching, and prevent abuse of the platform.
privacy.shown_body: A post's area is shown as a zone of at least 200 metres, never the exact spot. Your number is shown only if you choose to be messaged on WhatsApp.
privacy.sharing_body: With the providers that run the service — hosting, email, SMS and notifications — and only for that. We don't sell your data.
privacy.retention_body: While your account or your post is active, and afterwards only what the law requires. Contact details someone leaves on a post without an account are deleted once the post is no longer available.
privacy.rights_body: You can access, update, correct and ask us to delete your data, withdraw your consent and complain to the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce. Write to {contact}: we answer questions within 10 business days and complaints within 15.
privacy.consent_body: By creating your account or leaving your details on a post you consent to this processing.
